## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `aws-s3-setup-guide`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Sign in to the AWS Management Console

1. <!-- manual: Go to [console.aws.amazon.com](https://console.aws.amazon.com/) and sign in. -->
2. <!-- manual: In the top navigation bar, select the AWS Region where you want to create your S3 buckets (for example, us-east-1). -->

## Step 3: Create an IAM user

1. <!-- manual: Open the IAM console at [console.aws.amazon.com/iam/](https://console.aws.amazon.com/iam/). -->
2. In the left navigation pane, select **Users**, then select **Create user**.
3. Enter a **User name** (for example, `ballerina-s3-connector`).
4. Select **Next**.
5. <!-- manual: Enter a User name (for example, ballerina-s3-connector) and select Next. -->
6. Under **Set permissions**, select **Attach policies directly**.
7. Search for and select **AmazonS3FullAccess** managed policy (or a custom policy with the minimum S3 permissions your integration requires).
8. Select **Next**, review the details, and select **Create user**.
9. <!-- manual: review the details -->

## Step 4: Generate access keys

1. <!-- manual: In the IAM console, select the user you just created. -->
2. <!-- manual: Go to the Security credentials tab. -->
3. Under **Access keys**, select **Create access key**.
4. Select **Application running outside AWS** use case.
5. Select **Next**.
6. Optionally add a description tag, then select **Create access key**.
7. <!-- manual: Copy the Access key ID and Secret access key — these are your accessKeyId and secretAccessKey. -->

## Step 5: Note your AWS region

1. <!-- manual: Identify the AWS Region for your S3 operations (for example, us-east-1, eu-west-1, ap-southeast-1). -->
